text:
maria-support: FYI customer ACME reporting broken mobile analytics chart — legend colors don’t match bars and tooltips show different values than the chart. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/01a2b3 (attached in their ticket)

customer-acme: repro steps we used: open Dashboard > Campaigns > Mobile (portrait) on iPhone 13 / iOS 16.5 / Safari. Legend order randomizes, labels shift one position to the right, tooltip displays totals for previous bucket. Happens intermittently after rotating the phone.

maria-support: Thanks — they say this started after last analytics deploy (~2026-12-08 03:12 UTC). Also seeing missing points (gapped line) for a few metrics that still show in raw events. Billing/API looks fine. No 500s on our side reported.

oliver-frontend: Can you paste the exact query/time range? also which chart type — stacked bar?

customer-acme: Time range: last 7d, metric=active_sessions, grouping=country, chart=stacked bar, sample org id=acme-prod, user id=uid-54321. Query id returned by console: q_20261208_009.

jason-eng: @oliver-frontend @maria-support I grabbed the app trace. On mobile the chart canvas width calculation is using a stale container size after toolbar collapse; that would shift legend layout. Also I see a small race in tooltip binding where index mapping uses DOM order instead of dataset index. Suspect CSS reflow + our tooltip index selector causing mismatch.

oliver-frontend: Ugh. That tracks. I pushed a quick local patch to guard tooltip-binding with dataset id. Patch: ```diff
- tooltipIndex = el.dataset.idx || getIndexFromDOM(el)
+ tooltipIndex = el.dataset.idx ?? datasetMapping.get(el)
```

maria-support: Is there a workaround we can send to the customer until fix? They asked for a mitigation and want to know if this affects billing/metrics accuracy.

jason-eng: Workaround: in mobile portrait, avoid collapsing the top toolbar (tap twice to keep it visible) — prevents the reflow. Also use the explicit "Export CSV" button; the raw numbers are correct server-side. This is purely client-side rendering bug, not data loss.

maria-support: Noted. I'll pass that along. Can we get an ETA for a fix and a PR/RC link to share?

oliver-frontend: I can ship a small patch today (FR: guard resize observer + tooltip binding). Will create PR and run quick QA on iPhone 12/13 sims. ETA: 4h for PR + 2h QA, then can roll as hotfix to canary.

jason-eng: Creating issue and linking traces: https://redwood.internal/trace/trace-8921, PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/2891 (WIP). I'll include unit for datasetMapping and an e2e repro that rotates viewport.

maria-support: Awesome. I'll open a support ticket update with workaround + promise to follow up after canary. Please ping this thread when PR merged and when canary has the fix. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Deploy pipeline queued for frontend/hotfix-2891 — canary target: us-west-2. Started at 2026-12-08T08:45:00Z.

oliver-frontend: Canary passed basic visual checks, but found another edge: with accessibility font-size scaling on iOS the legend overlaps chart by ~8px. Adding an extra layout pass to ensure legend anchors after resize should fix both. Updating PR.

maria-support: Thanks team. Customer notified with workaround and ETA. Will keep thread open for post-deploy verification.

customer-acme: Thanks all — appreciate the quick response. We'll test the canary once it's available and report back.
